_renderOrder.uiInfo: {"hint":"Render order for the edge fade overlay. Leave at 0 unless you need the fade in a specific band relative to other chrome — it already layers over its own content via a depth bias plus hierarchy order.", "showIf":"_edgeFade"}

_snapRegion.uiInfo: {"label":"Snap Region", "hint":"Per-axis size of each snap segment in local units.", "showIf":"_scrollSnapping"}

_maxSnapStepsPerFling.uiInfo: {"label":"Max Snap Steps Per Fling", "hint":"Maximum snap steps. 0 = unlimited. Paging uses Paging Cap Mode; Detent preserves detents crossed by dragging.", "showIf":"_scrollSnapping"}

_edgeFadeColor.uiInfo: {"hint":"Color the edge fade blends to. Defaults to the standard panel background; match your own backing panel color to fade over it.", "widget":"color", "showIf":"_edgeFade"}

properties.text: Select your favorite styles, select them and start populating your list.  Then click generate to let the magic happen!  Pro tips.  If you generate many clips, remember to position them evenly across your space to interact with them.  You can also grab this UI and move it around.  If a generation does not complete chances are that the Music Gen API blocked your request, please just try again.

_lyriaModel.uiInfo: {"hint":"Lyria 3 model id requested through the Remote Service Gateway Gemini endpoint"}

_spawnPosition.uiInfo: {"hint":"Scene object whose world position is used as the spawn point for new music objects"}

_useSnapCloud.uiInfo: {"hint":"Generate music with Lyria 3 (MP3, fits under the 4MB RemoteApi limit) and save each track to Snap Cloud Storage. When off, uses the original inline Lyria-002 path whose ~8MB WAV response currently exceeds the limit."}

_storageBucket.uiInfo: {"hint":"Supabase Storage bucket where generated tracks are saved (must exist)"}

_snapCloudRequirements.uiInfo: {"hint":"Reference to SnapCloudRequirements for centralized Supabase configuration"}

buttonHorizontalSpacing.uiInfo: {"hint":"Horizontal spacing in cm between adjacent menu buttons"}

addCallbacks.uiInfo: {"hint":"Enable this to add functions from another script to this component's callbacks"}

_inactive.uiInfo: {"hint":"Inactive Mode: set the element to ignore inputs"}

popup.uiInfo: {"hint":"Root SceneObject of the popup panel that appears when offline"}

_yawOffsetDegrees.uiInfo: {"label":"Yaw Offset Degrees", "hint":"How many degrees of offset from the center point should the SceneObject sit. Positive values place the element to the left."}

_yawEasing.uiInfo: {"label":"Yaw Easing", "hint":"How fast the SceneObject will follow along the yaw-axis. Use 0.1 for a delayed, smooth follow effect, or 1 for instant following."}

_yawBufferDegrees.uiInfo: {"label":"Yaw Buffer Degrees", "hint":"How many degrees of leeway along each direction (left/right) before the object starts to follow."}

_xzEnabled.uiInfo: {"label":"XZ Enabled", "hint":"When enabled, the SceneObject will follow when the user physically moves their head along the XZ-plane (horizontal movement)."}

_pitchOffsetDegrees.uiInfo: {"label":"Pitch Offset Degrees", "hint":"How many degrees of offset from the center point should the SceneObject sit. Positive values place the element below the center."}

_xzEasing.uiInfo: {"label":"XZ Easing", "hint":"How fast the SceneObject will follow along the XZ-plane. Use 0.1 for a delayed, smooth follow effect, or 1 for instant following."}

_translationBuffer.uiInfo: {"label":"Translation Buffer", "hint":"The magnitude of change (in cm) needed to activate a translation for the object to follow the camera. A small buffer helps prevent 'wobbling' when the user has an unstable head position."}

_pitchEasing.uiInfo: {"label":"Pitch Easing", "hint":"How fast the SceneObject will follow along the pitch-axis. Use 0.1 for a delayed, smooth follow effect, or 1 for instant following."}

_pitchBufferDegrees.uiInfo: {"label":"Pitch Buffer Degrees", "hint":"How many degrees of leeway along each direction (up/down) before the object starts to follow."}

_lockedPitch.uiInfo: {"label":"Locked Pitch", "hint":"When enabled, locks the SceneObject's position relative to the pitch-axis, keeping it fixed in place as the user rotates their head up/down."}

_yEnabled.uiInfo: {"label":"Y Enabled", "hint":"When enabled, the SceneObject will follow when the user physically moves their head along the Y-axis (vertical movement)."}

_yEasing.uiInfo: {"label":"Y Easing", "hint":"How fast the SceneObject will follow along the Y-axis. Use 0.1 for a delayed, smooth follow effect, or 1 for instant following."}

_lockedYaw.uiInfo: {"label":"Locked Yaw", "hint":"When enabled, locks the SceneObject's position relative to the yaw-axis, keeping it fixed in place as the user rotates their head left/right."}

_distance.uiInfo: {"label":"Distance", "hint":"How far away the SceneObject will be from the camera (in cm)."}

_yAxisEnabled.uiInfo: {"label":"Y Axis Enabled", "hint":"Enables yaw rotation of the object to face the camera. When enabled, the object rotates around its Y-axis to track camera position."}

_axisEasing.uiInfo: {"label":"Axis Easing", "hint":"Controls how fast the object rotates around each axis to follow camera movement. Configurable per axis (X,Y,Z) where higher values (1.0) create instant following, while lower values (0.1) create a delayed, smoother follow effect."}

_xAxisEnabled.uiInfo: {"label":"X Axis Enabled", "hint":"Enables pitch rotation of the object to face the camera. When enabled, the object rotates around its X-axis to maintain camera orientation."}

_zAxisEnabled.uiInfo: {"label":"Z Axis Enabled", "hint":"Enables roll rotation of the object to align with camera orientation. When enabled, the object rotates around its Z-axis to match camera's up direction."}

_uprightBandEnabled.uiInfo: {"label":"Upright Band Enabled", "hint":"When enabled, pitch (X-axis) rotation targets a vertical pill (capsule) around the object instead of the camera point. While the camera is within a vertical band around the object's height, the object stays upright; beyond the band's caps it pitches toward the camera. Requires X Axis Enabled.", "showIf":"_xAxisEnabled"}

_axisBufferDegrees.uiInfo: {"label":"Axis Buffer Degrees", "hint":"Defines a threshold in degrees before rotation is applied for each axis. The object only rotates when the angle between its orientation and the camera exceeds this buffer, preventing small unwanted movements. Larger values create more stable objects that rotate less frequently."}

properties.text:
⚠ This Lens needs credentials to work (a Remote Service Gateway token and a Snap Cloud (Supabase) project). Get the project from the repository and build it with your own credentials.

This Lens allows you to create music using the AI Lyria API by Google. 
 1. Look down and click on the button to spawn the music menu
2. Once the menu is visible start to pick your favorite styles to mix together on the carousel
3. Press on Generate and wait for your creation to finsh
4. Click on Play to hear to your new creation  Requirements: Set up Snap Cloud storage bucket to stored generated audio and Edge Function to transcode to the right format - see README.md
